routes.label_vi: Vật liệu bề mặt theo mô hình OpenPBR
routes.summary: ShaderNodeBsdfPrincipled is described as a physically based surface shader based on OpenPBR; Material.node_tree holds the material's node tree.
routes.choose_when: Use a physically based surface shader; read subsurface or scattering methods when those properties are required.
do_not_assume: The class page does not list all inputs or a complete material recipe. Read node/socket data and probe the runtime; do not supply remembered socket names, values or links.

evidence.supports: Describe an OpenPBR-based physically based surface shader.
Expose the node tree of a node-based material.

routes.label_vi: Dùng tệp ảnh làm texture
routes.summary: ShaderNodeTexImage samples an image file as a texture, with documented extension, interpolation and FLAT, BOX, SPHERE and TUBE projection modes.
routes.choose_when: Use an image file in a shader network and select projection from its documented contract.
do_not_assume: Projection documentation does not establish UV availability, a loaded image or shader connections. Inspect inputs before choosing links.

evidence.supports: Sample an image as a texture; projection describes ways to project a 2D image.

routes.label_vi: Texture nhiễu Perlin dạng fractal
routes.summary: ShaderNodeTexNoise generates fractal Perlin noise in one to four dimensions; noise types describe sharp peaks, peaks/valleys and terrain-like signals.
routes.choose_when: Supply noise to a shader network. Terrain wording describes the signal, not a terrain geometry recipe.
do_not_assume: A noise name does not establish a complete node network or terrain mesh. Read noise_type, dimensions and actual sockets before connecting.

evidence.supports: Generate fractal Perlin noise; noise_dimensions and noise_type describe dimensionality and noise forms.

routes.label_vi: Giả chi tiết bề mặt bằng height texture
routes.summary: ShaderNodeBump perturbs normals from a height texture to simulate surface detail; invert points bumps into the surface.
routes.choose_when: Use a height texture to simulate surface detail through normals.
do_not_assume: The description establishes normal changes, not geometry or silhouette changes. Confirm relevant sockets from skill data/runtime.

evidence.supports: Generate a perturbed normal from a height texture to simulate detailed surfaces.

routes.label_vi: Giả chi tiết bằng ảnh normal RGB
routes.summary: ShaderNodeNormalMap perturbs normals from an RGB normal image; the API describes OpenGL/DirectX conventions, normal spaces and tangent-space UV maps.
routes.choose_when: The input is an RGB normal map; choose convention and space from the actual image data.
do_not_assume: Do not guess image convention or normal space. This route describes normals that simulate detail, not mesh changes.

evidence.supports: Generate perturbed normals from an RGB normal map; describe convention, space and uv_map.

routes.label_vi: Gộp các thành phần shading thể tích
routes.summary: ShaderNodeVolumePrincipled combines volume-shading components in one node.
routes.choose_when: Discover a source-supported volume shader configuration.
do_not_assume: The description does not supply smoke/fire simulation or a fog recipe. Do not assign those workflows without related evidence; inspect sockets and engine support.

evidence.supports: Combine all volume-shading components in one node.

routes.label_vi: Shader phát xạ Lambertian
routes.summary: ShaderNodeEmission is described as a Lambertian emission shader.
routes.choose_when: Add an emission component to a shader; consider compositor glare when the request specifically concerns halos around bright image regions.
do_not_assume: This description does not establish automatic halos or illumination of other objects in every engine. Do not fill unsupported details from memory.

evidence.supports: Describe a Lambertian emission shader.
Glare separately adds flares, fog and glow around bright image regions.

routes.label_vi: Bóng vật thể trong cảnh và shadow rays
routes.summary: Object.visible_shadow controls visibility to shadow rays. AreaLight.shadow_soft_size describes light size for ray-traced shadow sampling; Light.use_shadow has only type/default information in the source.
routes.choose_when: Explore scene-object, light or shadow-ray controls; continue reading object, light and engine evidence.
do_not_assume: Light.use_shadow does not document a complete shadow algorithm. Do not assume increasing AreaLight.shadow_soft_size guarantees softer shadows in every engine; AreaLight.size describes source area separately. This corpus does not supply a complete soft-shadow recipe; implement supported parts and report remaining evidence gaps.

evidence.supports: Control object visibility to shadow rays.
Set light size for ray-traced shadow sampling without a complete engine-specific softness contract.
Set area-light size, or X dimension for rectangular lights.

routes.label_vi: Bắt bóng và phản xạ để ghép vào footage thật
routes.summary: Object.is_shadow_catcher renders only shadows and reflections on an object for compositing into real footage. Flagged objects are considered present in the footage; unflagged objects are synthetic additions.
routes.choose_when: Composite synthetic objects into footage where an existing surface should receive rendered shadows/reflections.
do_not_assume: The anchor does not establish supported engines or a camera, lighting and compositing recipe. A flag alone does not complete the composite; read further and verify runtime/render output.

evidence.supports: Render shadows and reflections for real-footage compositing; describe the roles of flagged and unflagged objects.

routes.label_vi: Quan hệ nhận sáng và chặn sáng theo collection
routes.summary: ObjectLightLinking.receiver_collection defines an emitter's light-linking relationships; blocker_collection defines objects blocking that emitter's light.
routes.choose_when: Control emitter relationships with receiver collections or light-blocker collections.
do_not_assume: The source does not establish support in every engine. Read collection contracts and editing APIs and check the actual engine before promising an effect.

evidence.supports: A collection defines emitter light-linking relationships.
A collection defines objects blocking light from the emitter.

routes.label_vi: Chọn nguồn sáng điểm, tia song song, nón hoặc diện tích
routes.label_en: Point, sun, spot and area light sources
routes.summary: The source describes POINT as omnidirectional, SUN as fixed-direction parallel rays, SPOT as a directional cone and AREA as a directional area source. BlendDataLights.new creates a light data-block.
routes.choose_when: Choose a light-source shape before reading PointLight, SunLight, SpotLight or AreaLight properties.
do_not_assume: Source shape does not provide appropriate power, position, exposure or shadow settings. Derive these from the request, supplied evidence and output checks.

evidence.supports: Describe POINT, SUN, SPOT and AREA source shapes.
Create a light data-block using the type enum.

routes.label_vi: Render ảnh hoặc dải frame
routes.summary: bpy.ops.render.render parameters describe animation rendering over a scene frame range; write_still saves to the output path when animation is off; frame_start/frame_end bound animation rendering.
routes.choose_when: Render a still or frame range; read RenderSettings for requested paths, dimensions and formats.
do_not_assume: The operator introduction says Undocumented, but parameters have descriptions. The engine enum lists only BLENDER_EEVEE in this snapshot; it is not a complete runtime inventory and does not justify remembered Cycles settings.

evidence.supports: Describe animation, write_still, frame_start, frame_end and scene.
Expose engine with the snapshot's BLENDER_EEVEE enum.

routes.label_vi: Xuất shadow pass
routes.summary: ViewLayer.use_pass_shadow is described as delivering a shadow pass.
routes.choose_when: Obtain a separate shadow layer for later rendering/compositing.
do_not_assume: The source does not define pixel values, compositing formulas or engine availability. Enabling the flag does not prove correct pass data; read pass access APIs and inspect a real render.

evidence.supports: Deliver a shadow pass.

routes.label_vi: Render nền world trong suốt
routes.summary: RenderSettings.film_transparent makes the world background transparent for compositing over another background.
routes.choose_when: Composite the rendered world background over another image.
do_not_assume: The property does not establish alpha-capable file output, remove scene background geometry or supply a compositing recipe. Read output-format and scene-data contracts.

evidence.supports: Make the world background transparent for compositing over another background.

routes.label_vi: Bake image texture của vật thể được chọn
routes.summary: bpy.ops.object.bake bakes selected-object image textures; use_selected_to_active bakes selected objects' shading onto the active object; type describes passes and engine limitations.
routes.choose_when: Bake textures with identified source objects, active object and required pass type.
do_not_assume: Read pass/target enums and confirm selection, active object and engine support. Do not supply remembered high-poly/low-poly recipes or pass choices.

evidence.supports: Bake image textures with selected-to-active behavior, pass engine limitations and target/save_mode parameters.

routes.label_vi: Exposure, gamma và chuyển đổi màu hiển thị
routes.summary: ColorManagedViewSettings controls image display; exposure scales by 2^exposure before the display transform and gamma applies afterward, with white-balance and view_transform properties.
routes.choose_when: Adjust display color transformation, exposure or white balance rather than surface shader properties.
do_not_assume: The snapshot's view_transform enum lists only NONE; do not choose AgX, Filmic or looks from memory. Inspect runtime color configurations; exposure changes are not light-power changes.

evidence.supports: Describe display color management, exposure/gamma order, white balance and view transforms.

routes.label_vi: Làm mờ ảnh bằng compositor
routes.summary: CompositorNodeBlur blurs images with multiple blur modes.
routes.choose_when: Blur an image in the compositor.
do_not_assume: The class description does not enumerate sockets or detailed modes. Do not use remembered older blur properties; read supplied metadata and inspect runtime sockets.

evidence.supports: Blur images with multiple modes.

routes.label_vi: Quầng sáng, flare và fog quanh vùng sáng của ảnh
routes.label_en: Glare, flares and glow in an image
routes.summary: CompositorNodeGlare adds lens flares, fog and glow around bright image regions.
routes.choose_when: Create effects around bright image regions, often requested as glow or bloom.
do_not_assume: The bloom alias maps intent; it does not establish a BLOOM enum or Eevee bloom property. Obtain modes, thresholds and sockets from skill data/runtime.

evidence.supports: Add lens flares, fog and glow around bright image regions.

routes.label_vi: Tách phông theo màu và khử ám màu phông
routes.summary: CompositorNodeKeying removes a backdrop through chroma keying and corrects backdrop color spill.
routes.choose_when: Remove a backdrop by color and optionally correct its color cast.
do_not_assume: The source does not promise arbitrary background removal or automatic key-color detection. Inspect image data and supported sockets/values; do not infer semantic segmentation.

evidence.supports: Remove a backdrop through chroma keying and correct its color cast with despill.

routes.label_vi: Ghép ảnh foreground lên background
routes.summary: CompositorNodeAlphaOver overlays a foreground image on a background.
routes.choose_when: Combine identified foreground and background images.
do_not_assume: The description does not establish socket index order, straight/premultiplied handling or background removal. Read socket and alpha-source contracts before linking.

evidence.supports: Overlay a foreground image on a background image.

routes.label_vi: Ghi ảnh từ compositor ra tệp
routes.summary: CompositorNodeOutputFile writes image files; this snapshot exposes directory, file_name, file_output_items and format.
routes.choose_when: Save compositor output with specified paths and formats.
do_not_assume: Do not use remembered base_path/file_slots properties when this snapshot documents directory/file_output_items. Path-template documentation is external and unbundled; do not invent missing template syntax.

evidence.supports: Write image files with this version's directory, file_name, file_output_items and format properties.

routes.label_vi: Khử nhiễu ảnh render ray tracing
routes.summary: CompositorNodeDenoise is described as denoising Cycles and other ray-traced renders.
routes.choose_when: Denoise a ray-traced render in the compositor.
do_not_assume: The class does not fully document required sockets, auxiliary passes or denoiser libraries. Read available data and verify the runtime instead of supplying remembered Cycles configuration.

evidence.supports: Denoise Cycles and other ray-traced renders.

routes.label_vi: Độ sâu trường ảnh 2D từ Z depth hoặc mask
routes.label_en: 2D depth of field from depth or mask
routes.summary: CompositorNodeDefocus applies 2D depth of field using a Z-depth map or mask, with documented bokeh, f_stop, blur_max and use_zbuffer.
routes.choose_when: Apply depth of field during image processing using depth or mask data.
do_not_assume: This is not camera optics configuration or proof that depth/mask data exists. Read the distinction between Z-buffer and image inputs and inspect the data.

evidence.supports: Apply 2D depth of field using a Z-depth map or mask, with bokeh and f_stop.

routes.label_vi: Tạo matte riêng cho object hoặc material
routes.summary: CompositorNodeCryptomatteV2 creates object/material mattes from Cryptomatte render passes; ViewLayer.use_pass_cryptomatte_object outputs a pass for object isolation.
routes.choose_when: Create object/material mattes from a render or image containing Cryptomatte passes.
do_not_assume: This is not object recognition in arbitrary images. Confirm passes and IDs, read source/layer_name and verify engine support.

evidence.supports: Create individual object/material mattes from Cryptomatte passes with RENDER or IMAGE sources.
Render an object pass for isolation during compositing.

routes.label_vi: Thêm chữ vào video bằng text strip
routes.summary: TextStrip generates text with content, font, size, position, alignment, outline and box properties. StripsTopLevel.new_effect includes TEXT for adding a text strip.
routes.choose_when: Add text over specified intervals in a video sequence.
do_not_assume: The source does not establish speech recognition or automatic subtitle timing. The default font falls back to a UI font; inspect the supplied font and required glyph rendering.

evidence.supports: A sequence strip generates text and exposes text-display properties.
The TEXT effect adds a simple text strip.

routes.label_vi: Bóng phía sau chữ trong video
routes.summary: TextStrip.use_shadow displays a shadow behind text; the class also exposes shadow_angle, shadow_blur, shadow_color and shadow_offset with types/ranges.
routes.choose_when: Apply a shadow to Video Sequencer text, distinct from 3D shadow rays or footage shadow catchers.
do_not_assume: shadow_blur/offset have type/range information without complete pixel-unit semantics. Do not transfer CSS numbers or 3D light controls by assumption.

evidence.supports: Display a shadow behind text.
TextStrip generates text and exposes shadow parameters with types/ranges.

routes.label_vi: Nạp video và trim nội dung strip
routes.summary: MovieStrip loads video; StripsTopLevel.new_movie adds a clip by file, channel and frame_start. content_trim_start/end skip source frames and turn corresponding time into holds.
routes.choose_when: Load a clip into the timeline or adjust source content at its ends according to the documented trimming semantics.
do_not_assume: The source marks animation_offset_start/end deprecated since 5.10 in favor of content_trim_start/end. Do not assume source trimming shortens the timeline; read frame ranges and inspect results.

evidence.supports: A sequence strip loads video; document content trimming and deprecation.
Add a movie strip with filepath, channel and frame_start.

routes.label_vi: Âm thanh theo timeline và volume
routes.label_en: Timed audio strips and playback volume
routes.summary: SoundStrip plays audio over an interval; volume controls level, pan applies to mono sources and sound_offset is measured in seconds. StripsTopLevel.new_sound adds a sound strip.
routes.choose_when: Place audio on the timeline and adjust timing, volume or pan as documented.
do_not_assume: A sound strip does not establish codec or mixdown support. Pan is limited to mono sources; inspect media and audio output separately.

evidence.supports: Describe timed audio, volume, mono pan and sound_offset in seconds.
Add a sound strip from a file at a timeline position.

routes.label_vi: Chuyển cảnh, blend, blur và đổi tốc độ strip
routes.summary: StripsTopLevel.new_effect describes CROSS fading, WIPE transitions, GLOW on bright regions, SPEED playback time-warping, GAUSSIAN_BLUR detail softening and blending effects.
routes.choose_when: Create timeline strip effects or transitions, selecting types from new_effect descriptions.
do_not_assume: Read each effect's inputs and settings; do not assume every effect takes two strips or uses older properties. SPEED does not establish optical-flow interpolation.

evidence.supports: Describe CROSS, WIPE, GLOW, SPEED, GAUSSIAN_BLUR and blending effects.

routes.label_vi: Hiệu ứng bóng cho Grease Pencil
routes.summary: ShaderFx affects Grease Pencil objects. ShaderFxShadow provides shadow offset, color, scale, rotation and pixel blur; ObjectShaderFx.new adds an effect.
routes.choose_when: Apply the documented shadow effect to an existing Grease Pencil object.
do_not_assume: A request for a 2D shadow does not extend this route to arbitrary images or meshes. Verify object type, effect enum and render behavior; the source is not a complete recipe.

evidence.supports: Effects apply to Grease Pencil objects.
Describe a shadow effect with offset, shadow_color, scale, rotation and pixel blur.
Add a shader effect by name and type.

routes.label_vi: Hiệu ứng glow của Grease Pencil
routes.summary: ShaderFxGlow is a Grease Pencil effect with glow_color, mode, opacity, size and a color-selection threshold; use_glow_under has a Regular blend-mode limitation.
routes.choose_when: Apply glow to a Grease Pencil object rather than a compositor image or emission shader.
do_not_assume: The glow name does not determine mode or size. Read blending rules and verify the runtime; the source does not support use_glow_under with Regular blend mode.

evidence.supports: ShaderFx affects Grease Pencil objects.
Describe glow parameters and the use_glow_under limitation with Regular blend mode.

routes.label_vi: Đường viền, silhouette và cạnh Freestyle
routes.summary: FreestyleLineSet associates lines with styles and selects contours, silhouettes, creases and other edges; FreestyleSettings offers scripting/parameter-editor modes and a separate render pass.
routes.choose_when: Select and render documented edge/contour types through FreestyleLineSet.
do_not_assume: This is not every Grease Pencil workflow or a guarantee of any cartoon style. Read edge selection, style and engine contracts; the snapshot is not a complete artistic recipe.

evidence.supports: Select contours, silhouettes, creases and material boundaries and reference a linestyle.
Configure Freestyle per ViewLayer with SCRIPT/EDITOR modes and as_render_pass.

routes.label_vi: Theo dõi marker trong footage
routes.summary: MovieTracking holds match-moving data; bpy.ops.clip.track_markers tracks selected markers backward or across a sequence rather than one image.
routes.choose_when: Track markers in footage; inspect clip/tracking data before invoking the operator.
do_not_assume: Marker tracking is not arbitrary object recognition. It requires suitable context and selection; do not promise background CLI operation without a successful poll in that context.

evidence.supports: Expose match-moving data for tracking.
Track selected markers backward or across a sequence.

routes.label_vi: Ổn định footage 2D dựa trên marker
routes.summary: MovieTrackingStabilization stabilizes footage in 2D using markers, with location/rotation/scale influence, an anchor frame and automatic scaling to cover gaps.
routes.choose_when: Stabilize 2D footage using existing tracking data.
do_not_assume: This does not establish correction of all shake or rolling shutter. Suitable tracks and output checks are required; the route does not automatically create tracking input.

evidence.supports: Describe marker-based 2D stabilization with anchor frame, location/rotation/scale and autoscale.

routes.label_vi: Giải chuyển động camera từ tracks
routes.summary: bpy.ops.clip.solve_camera solves camera motion from tracks. MovieTrackingReconstruction stores solved cameras, average_error and is_valid.
routes.choose_when: Solve camera motion from existing tracks and inspect reconstruction validity/error.
do_not_assume: The source does not guarantee a solve for all footage or supply complete calibration/background-context requirements. Report success only when the actual operator and reconstruction support it.

evidence.supports: Solve camera motion from tracks.
Expose reconstruction cameras, average_error and is_valid.
